title: Claim Excess Payments Taken from a ShieldCare Customer
content:
## The request this covers

A customer may ask to settle the excess standing against a claim on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan.
What the account settles on a claim excess is fixed only after that excess stands billed on the plan. What
is then taken is recorded as an excess payment against that claim, and the claim excess still owed on the
plan falls by the amount paid.

## Recording the payment

The payment is recorded with `settle_claim_deductible_46d57fef`. This is the customer's own tool: it is
unlocked and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it, since paying money against their own claim is
their act and not the agent's. One call records a single excess payment against the named claim on the named
plan and lowers the claim excess still owed on that plan by the amount paid, so the plan shows what is left
owing straight away. The customer sees the payment against the claim and the reduced balance on the plan.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the claim sits on, as read out to the customer from the plan record. |
| `claim_reference` | Copied verbatim: the claim reference the retailer issued when the incident was taken, character for character from the claim entry read out to the customer, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `settlement_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: what the customer is paying toward the excess, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |
| `payment_method` | An enumerated value: how the customer is paying, one of `card_on_file`, the payment card already held on the profile; `store_credit`, the balance of store credit on the profile; `bank_transfer`, money sent from the customer's bank account; `in_store_cash`, cash or card handed over at a branch counter; `business_invoice`, the amount put on the invoice account a business profile settles on terms. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new payment entry, a string
beginning pdp_, the claim and plan it was applied to, the amount paid in USD to two decimal places, and the
claim excess still outstanding on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Claim excess
payment received" means the money was taken and the plan's outstanding excess was reduced.
